title: eBoi book (import/export format, version 1)
description: One book as used by Admin > Import / export. Export a book to get a filled-in example. Match order on import: book_code, then slug. A match is updated; otherwise a new book is created. Cover and preview files are uploaded next to the JSON, never referenced by URL.

book_code.description: Optional. The human Book ID. If it exists, that book is updated. If it does not exist, the new book gets this code. Leave it out to get the next free code.

slug.description: Permanent link: /books/<slug>. Changing it later is safe (old links redirect).

file_size.description: Size of the FULL pdf, e.g. "8.4 MB". Display only.

description.description: Plain text. A blank line starts a new paragraph.

old_price.description: Optional manual struck-through price. Must be higher than price.

offer_id.description: Optional pinned offer. Usually null: offers target books from the Offers page.

total_sells.description: Public display value. Logging a sale adds 1 automatically.

views.description: Public display value. Real visits add to it automatically.

internal_file_note.description: Private. Where the full PDF lives on your computer. Never shown on the site.

collections.description: Collection slugs. Replaces the book's collections. Unknown slugs are skipped and reported.

files.description: Informational only: the file names you intend to upload with this JSON. The importer warns if the chosen files have different names.
